problems.problem: Unchanged from the first reading: the plain sense still carries the refrain ‘all the others die away’ with nothing to say who the others are, and the key verse is printed without the refrain. The revision (‘godless foes’) was refuted because it put Sāyaṇa’s gloss on 8.39.1 into the plain sense, and the batch kept the old sentence, so the fault stands.
problems.fix: Use the refuter’s sentence, which passes entry-check and ties the refrain to the hymn’s own words at 8.39.2 without borrowing Sāyaṇa: ‘A hymn to Agni that bids the destroyers go wishes in every verse that all the others die away; Sāyaṇa, on 8.39.4, reads the delight as happiness born of calm and of sense contact, and takes Agni as doing all, whatever god is invoked.’

problems.problem: Unchanged from the first reading: ‘Closing a hymn to Soma’ is inexact (9.58 has four verses and the key is verse 3), and ‘made their gain as if unaccepted’ leaves the image without its point (why the gift weighed on the seers). The revision was refuted because it dropped ‘cites the Śāṭyāyanaka’ and made the Brāhmaṇa story Sāyaṇa’s own reading, so the batch kept the old sentence.
problems.fix: Use the refuter’s sentence, which keeps the citation and passes entry-check: ‘Near a Soma hymn’s close, the singers turn to gifts received; Sāyaṇa, on 9.58.3, takes the givers as kings and cites the Śāṭyāyanaka, where two seers, feeling like swallowers of poison at so much, saw this hymn, and their wealth counted as taken, not accepted.’

problems.problem: House style: the Yāska revision kept the double curly quotes, “deep thought”, where the rest of the batch (d65 now included) and veda-01 and veda-02 quote key words in single curly quotes.
problems.fix: Change “deep thought” to ‘deep thought’; nothing else.

problems.problem: House style: “troubles” is still in double curly quotes; the d65 reviser noted the same fix was due here and had no write path for it.

The src lines and the place form in the sentences are still inconsistent across the batch, as in the first reading: ‘Vedārthaprakāśa, commentary on …’ (d65 to d70), ‘Vedārthaprakāśa on …’ (d71, d77 to d94), ‘Vedārthaprakāśa, on …’ (d72 to d76), and d95 and d96 ‘on Rig Veda m.h.v, Sanskrit Wikisource, revision …’ without the page name the others carry. In the sentences, d65, d67 to d70, d83, d85 to d88 say ‘commentary on m.h.v’ where the rest say ‘on m.h.v’.
problems.fix: Bring every Sāyaṇa src to one form, e.g. ‘Sāyaṇa, Vedārthaprakāśa on m.h.v, sa.wikisource ऋग्वेदः सूक्तं m.h, revision N (year)’, keeping ‘(standard m.h.v)’ for app Book 8 numbers and adding the page name to d95 (ऋग्वेदः सूक्तं ९.४२) and d96 (ऋग्वेदः सूक्तं ९.५८). Use one place form in the sentences (‘on m.h.v’), checking each changed sentence with entry-check.
